notes.title: Stocksynd House - 1.5 update released
notes.content:
Overview
We are super excited to announce the release of the 1.5 update for Stocksynd House!
There are loads of awesome treats in store for you, with a ton of new gameplay, fixes, optimizations and various other bits and pieces.

Firstly, we listened to the feedback and have expanded more areas within the game. There are new puzzles that make some areas much tougher to complete than previously. Even if you have played through before, its well worth going back through again to see what is new. We are confident you will be met with some very interesting surprises!

On top of all this, we have added some great new features to the brand new game mode 'The SyndBox'. Once unlocked you can just head in there by simply selecting the SyndBox monitor from the menu room, where you will be able to play around with the physics and generally have fun; I personally recommend exploring the SyndBox Duplication Station in the kitchen.

Release Notes

Two chapters dramatically enhanced (no spoilers)
New puzzles added to some chapters (no spoilers)
Kids toy block assembly room added to the SyndBox 
Body no longer collides with doors
Held objects no longer get destroyed when moving to a new chapter
New loading screen with pull trigger to start mechanism
General lighting improvements
General under the hood fixes and improvements


As always I don't want to say too much here as I don't want to give anything away. 

We really hope you enjoy this update as much as we did working on it.

Kind regards and stay safe!
CyberFlux Games.

notes.title: Stocksynd House - 1.4.f4 update released
notes.content:
A small subset of players recently experienced issues with extremely poor graphics fidelity and objects not showing in the game. 

Thanks to the players that reported this and helped us investigate, we have been able to implement and release a fix to ensure that this no longer happens.

We are sorry for any inconvenience with your Stocksynd fun time and hope that you can now enjoy the game as we originally intended!

notes.title: Stocksynd House - 1.4 update released
notes.content:
Hi, us again!

We are back to give you another super exciting update to Stocksynd House. Other than a few minor tweaks under the hood, we have got 2 amazing new features for you.

Firstly, SyndBox mode. This is a whole new game mode. I don't want to spoil the surprises so just go in and have a look around. Trust me it's rather fun!

Secondly, we have added an ambient occlusion option to the whiteboard in the menu room. Basically, this will make the game look even sexier! But be warned, this is quite taxing on your graphics card, so we'd recommend you only enable it if you have a really beefy GPU!

1.4 Release Notes

 New game mode added
 Added option for AO - High-end GPUs only!


We hope you enjoy this update. Have fun and stay safe!

Kindest regards
CyberFlux Games

notes.title: Stocksynd House - 1.3 update released
notes.content:
As we draw closer to the end of the first week for Stocksynd House we would really like to thank everyone that has bought the game. We really appreciate the extremely kind and incredibly constructive feedback that we have received.

We released a minor update already but this is the first major update and we are super excited to find out what you all think. 
We have fixed a few bugs, tweaked some optimization and added some additional spookiness!
Obviously, due to the nature of Stocksynd House, we can't tell you exactly what we have updated as it will spoil the surprises. Check below for a list of vague points that should give you enough of an idea.


1.3 Release Notes:

 Added global audio volume control in menu room
 Increased movement speed for some areas
 Optimized game loading - Sexy new loading screen and its much quicker!
 Seriously ramped up the terror in one sequence - Not telling you which, but you'll know when you see it!
 Adjusted some slightly loud SFX. E.g. cabinet doors
 Reorganized some puzzle elements a little - no details to avoid spoilers.
 Fixed a couple of very minor story related bugs
 Fixed some floor surfaces playing incorrect walking SFX
 Some minor tweaks to interactable objects
 Some minor UI tweaks


We really hope you enjoy this update and hope you all stay safe.

Kindest regards
Cyberflux Games

notes.title: Stocksynd House - Version 1.2.f2 released
notes.content:
Following the launch of Stocksynd House we have made two very minor additions.


 We made the basketball sound like a basketball when bounces.
 We added a hint in the folder regarding how to turn your flashlight on and off.


And that is it for now!
